The presence of a high confidence score in the relationship between Chrysanthemic Acid, Ethyl Ester and ECC10, along with the established target relationship between ECC10 and DNA polymerase nu, supports the hypothesis that Chrysanthemic Acid, Ethyl Ester may influence DNA polymerase nu via ECC10.
